# Missingness posterior stress

Opt-in `impute_posterior` under a MAR claim, then `run_lmtp_grid(...; imputation=draws)`
with Rubin pooling. Cheap `:drop` / `:ipcw` remain the defaults. Turing / RxInfer
backends are deferred.

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-setup
#| warning: false

using Pkg
const PKG_ROOT = normpath(joinpath(@__DIR__, "..", ".."))
const BOOK_ROOT = normpath(joinpath(PKG_ROOT, "..", ".."))
if isfile(joinpath(BOOK_ROOT, "Project.toml"))
    Pkg.activate(BOOK_ROOT)
else
    Pkg.activate(joinpath(PKG_ROOT, "docs"))
end
Pkg.instantiate()

using CausalTargeted
using CausalDynamics
using DataFrames
using StableRNGs
using Statistics
```

```{julia}
#| label: chunk-posterior-mar-lmtp
#| warning: false

df, truth = CausalTargeted.simulate_missing_outcome_mtp(200; rng = StableRNG(60))
sdA = std(skipmissing(df.A))
δ = 1.0 * sdA
te = truth.effects(δ).te
cert = certify_missingness(MissingnessSpec(:Y; regime = :mar, conditioning_set = [:W]))
draws = impute_posterior(
    df, :Y, [:W];
    treatment = :A, certificate = cert, n_draws = 8, rng = StableRNG(60),
)
est_post = run_lmtp_grid(
    df, :A, :Y; baseline = [:W], deltas = [δ],
    folds = 2, learners_outcome = (:glm, :mean), learners_trt = (:glm, :mean),
    parallel = false, simultaneous = false, cache_nuisances = false,
    rng = StableRNG(60), shift_scale = "raw", imputation = draws,
)
est_drop = run_lmtp_grid(
    df, :A, :Y; baseline = [:W], deltas = [δ],
    folds = 2, learners_outcome = (:glm, :mean), learners_trt = (:glm, :mean),
    parallel = false, simultaneous = false, cache_nuisances = false,
    rng = StableRNG(60), shift_scale = "raw", handle_missing = :drop,
)
ψ_post = Float64(only(est_post.est))
ψ_drop = Float64(only(est_drop.est))
@assert isfinite(ψ_post) && isfinite(ψ_drop)
@assert missingness_metadata(est_post).strategy === :posterior_gaussian_mar
ledger = DataFrame(
    method = ["oracle", "posterior", "drop"],
    te = [te, ψ_post, ψ_drop],
    abs_err = [0.0, abs(ψ_post - te), abs(ψ_drop - te)],
)
println(ledger)
ledger
```
